# EKUZO

> EKUZO is a youth esports coaching organization that builds transformational programs for kids through structured practice, skilled coaching, and real competition. Tagline: Every Gamer Deserves a Team.

EKUZO runs three programs: **EKUZO Camps** (1-week intensive summer camps), **EKUZO100** (a 4-week intro program for individual gamers), and **EKUZO Teams** (a semester-based school-partnered program). All programs are fully online, run by professional coaches, and center on League of Legends with additional titles coming. The organization is based in Houston, Texas and serves the United States and North America.

Founded in 2021 by Karlin "Faith" Oei — a former peak Challenger League of Legends jungler and national collegiate captain who won over $80,000 in esports scholarships. The head coach is Sebastien "ZzLegendary" DeMontigny, who previously coached at Dignitas and Evil Geniuses.

EKUZO's pedagogy treats esports the way traditional school sports treat athletic development: consistent teammates, coach-led practice, a real season, and deliberate skill-building. The emphasis is as much on social-emotional growth (teamwork, resilience, time management, digital citizenship) as on in-game mechanics.

## Programs

- [EKUZO Camps](https://ekuzo.gg/programs/ekuzo-camps): Intensive 1-week online summer esports camp. Monday–Friday, 3 hours per day, morning and afternoon slots. Ten weekly cohorts from May 18 through August 6, 2026. $199 per week. For gamers who want a focused, high-intensity introduction to team esports during school breaks.
- [EKUZO100](https://ekuzo.gg/programs/ekuzo100): 4-week intro program for individual gamers. Two 90-minute sessions per week, coach-led, ~5 player teams. $100 total. The lowest-commitment way to experience structured team practice and see what EKUZO is about.
- [EKUZO Teams](https://ekuzo.gg/programs/ekuzo-teams): Semester-based esports program structured like a school sport. 16 weeks, two 90-minute sessions per week, same teammates and same coach all season. Fall 2026 semester runs August 31 through December 18. Pricing: $576 paid in full (10% discount) or 4 × $160 monthly installments ($640 total). Best fit for gamers ready for season-long commitment, and for schools partnering with EKUZO on an official esports program.
- [All programs overview](https://ekuzo.gg/programs): Side-by-side comparison of the three programs.

## Methodology and philosophy

- [Methodology](https://ekuzo.gg/methodology): EKUZO's full coaching philosophy, the 10 pillars of the program, how practice is structured, and what makes EKUZO different from unstructured online gaming.

- [For Schools](https://ekuzo.gg/schools): How schools partner with EKUZO to run an official esports program, including curriculum integration, coaching, and tournament organization.
- [Games](https://ekuzo.gg/games): The game titles EKUZO currently supports, with League of Legends as the primary platform.
